in_text_mentions: A 34-year-old asymptomatic woman underwent a chest radiography examination as an admission requirement for a new job. The X-ray showed focal hyperlucency in the left upper lobe of the lung (Figure 1A). High-resolution computed tomography (HRCT) was performed to confirm the findings (Figures 1B and 1C). The HRCT findings were characteristic of congenital lobar emphysema (CLE).
